fact_check.note: fixed in place: Source: 'nine hours... typically four to five'; Filipek 'nearly eight hours', 'around five car crashes'. The page said the replacement for a bus that slid off the road took 9 hours, which the source does not say. Reworded to the source's figures.

fact_check.claim: 'One bus turned back on I-80'

fact_check.note: fixed in place: Source: he felt he had to take the bus, otherwise he would not reach campus until Wednesday. Not 'the only way'. Fixed in text and the bus table.

fact_check.claim: Dec 1-2, 2019 row: OurBus cancelled; ShortLine bus slid off the road; flights through DC, Detroit and Houston cancelled
fact_check.note: fixed in place: Source: OurBus cancelled the majority of trips; the bus skidded sideways into bushes and blocked the highway (not named ShortLine in the source's wording checked); cancellations at DC and Detroit, Houston only the start. Row and bus-table cell corrected.

fact_check.claim: Cornell cancelled classes only after students were on the road; announcement after students on road

fact_check.note: fixed in place: Source: operators 'canceled all buses departing after noon on Saturday', in the context of a Coach USA ShortLine bus from NYC; Cuomo banned buses from most highways from Saturday 3 p.m. Row and bus table reworded; Cornell run and ban confirmed.
